exposure: patient characteristics (race, insurance, income, comorbidities like hypertension, obesity, preterm labor/delivery, seizure disorder)
cohort: Women who delivered in hospitals in California, Florida, and New York between 2004 and 2013, whose 30-day postpartum readmission rates were analyzed.
finding: Obstetric readmissions were more attributable to patient and demographic characteristics than to hospital characteristics.
